added.summary: Every look has three more shape images coloured by the element's fill: `nine-cross`, a d-pad's body, `nine-cross-rim`, its outline, and `nine-cross-arm`, its top arm in the same box (`rotate-90`, `rotate-180` and `-rotate-90` turn it to the others).

fixed.summary: The d-pad is one shape with one outline (`nine-cross` under `nine-cross-rim`) instead of two outlined bars under a cover, so no scale opens a seam in it: pressed (`active:scale-97`), the bars' inner outlines showed as faint lines across its middle. The arm of the way it reads now lights while it is held, two on a diagonal.
